notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Salvager of Secrets and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Salvager of Secrets tokens enter the battlefield, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
